subject: [VolPred Alert][INFO] P10 crypto-fear-channel full body draft complete (15p, 9 sections, 5 increment 完成)
body:
Alert level: info
Title: P10 crypto-fear-channel full body draft complete (15p, 9 sections, 5 increment 完成)

## 觸發條件

P10 crypto-fear-channel 從 intro-only (body_v0_intro.tex Apr 20) 到完整 9-section body_v5.tex (15 pages, 4,887 words) 完成 — 主線程 5 連續 slot 增量推進 2026-04-28：

- df11573e §2 Literature Review (~741 words)
- 9bbfbe16 §3 Data + §4 Methodology (~1,070 words)
- 4ef3c10d §5 Main Results + 4 tables (~923 words)
- dbdfcc08 §6 Robustness + §7 OOS forecasting + 1 table (~940 words)
- 8434d9ad §8 Discussion + §9 Conclusion (~1,213 words)
- 754bbe97 research_program.md status update

## 影響

直接服務 Mission 第 3 條（top-tier journal 投稿）。P10 從原 estimate 「2-3 週主線程 effort」實際在 5 slot 自主完成，per autonomous-platform CLAUDE.md「執行階段不問用戶 — 遇問題自行修流程、優化邏輯」+ p10_status_2026_04_27.md 「stop waiting for Codex body drafting」。

P10 contribution 三 stylized facts:
1. Asymmetric Granger: BTC- → VIX 全 5 lags F=6.64-18.96 p<10^-5; BTC+ → VIX 全不顯
2. Tail dependence with sign reversal: β=-2.86 (τ=0.05) → +22.31 (τ=0.95), 8.54× upper-tail amplification
3. Regime-dependent: 2020 only (F=11.05, p<10^-6), 4 個其他 subperiod NS

Plus: BTC net-receiver in DY (-76.9pp) → reframe 「fear amplifier conditional on equity stress」not originator
Plus: Honest OOS DM=-0.98 NULL (failed Harvey 2016 |t|>3) — 透明 reporting

## 6 Tables in body_v5

T1 Descriptive stats / T2 Asymmetric Granger / T3 QR by quantile /
T4 5-subperiod Granger / T5 DCC by VIX regime / T6 OOS forecast loss

## 建議行動

下個 slot 推進：
1. **reproduce.py expand** 7→~25 checks 涵蓋 6 tables 全 byte-binding (per .claude/rules/paper-workflow.md hard rule 3)
2. **main.tex rename** body_v5.tex → main.tex + final polish (abstract 與 §5-§9 narrative 對齊 + intro 引用 §6/§7/§8 cross-refs)
3. **paper-review-cycle 啟動** v1 round (latex-academic-reviewer + citation-verifier 並行)

Predicted timeline 升 ready_for_submission stage:
- 2 slot reproduce + main.tex polish
- 2-3 round review + revision
- ~10-15 slot total → 升 ready_for_submission

Target journal:
- 1st: Journal of International Financial Markets, Institutions & Money (IJFMIM)
- 2nd: Journal of Empirical Finance (JEF)
- Backup: Finance Research Letters (FRL, short-form)

無 user action 需 — 等下個 slot trigger 主線程繼續推進。
